model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (shape Request (sketch "A request."))
  (shape Event (sketch "A event."))
  (shape Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (shape Command (sketch "A command."))
  (shape Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port :in Event :as keep) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port :out Snapshot :as metric) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (block RetryRenderer :type "Service"
      (takes Receipt :as req)
      (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
    (adjacent
      (block LiveAuth :type "Service"
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
      (block EdgeUploader :type "Store"
        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
        (level
          (block Renderer
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))))
    (adjacent
      (block RetryLedger
        (takes Event)
        (gives Request :as done)
        (implements Observable)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Parser :type "Store"
        (takes Command)
        (gives Request :as done)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Router
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
    (block Planner
      (takes Request :as evt)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
      (level
        (adjacent
          (block RemoteMetrics
            (takes Receipt :as evt)
            (gives Receipt :as emit)
            (implements Observable)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block Uploader :type "Process"
            (takes Receipt :as evt)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block EdgeCatalog
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
          (block LiveQueue :type "Store"
            (takes Snapshot :as req)
            (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
        (adjacent
          (block BatchCatalog
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
          (block ShadowMetrics :type "Process"
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block BatchScheduler
                  (takes Receipt :as req)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block EdgeSearch
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
            (level
              (block Cache :type "Feature"
                (takes Event :as req)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
          (block LiveBilling :type "Process"
            (takes Receipt)
            (gives Event :as done)
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
          (block RetryFeed
            (takes Command :as evt)
            (gives Receipt)
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block Queue
                  (takes Snapshot :as evt)
                  (gives Receipt :as done)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block RemoteSearch
                  (takes Snapshot :as req)
                  (gives Receipt)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block Pricing :type "Service"
                  (takes Snapshot :as evt)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block LiveScheduler
                  (takes Command :as req)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                (block EdgeSync
                  (takes Command :as evt)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block Ledger
                  (takes Event :as req)
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                (block Scheduler
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
              (adjacent
                (block Search
                  (gives Event :as emit)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block LocalMailer
                  (takes Request :as evt)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))))
      (level
        (block Inbox
          (takes Snapshot)
          (gives Command)
          (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
        (block RetryInbox
          (takes Command)
          (gives Event)
          (implements Observable)
          (sketch "Thin wrapper.")
          (level
            (adjacent
              (block RetryBilling :type "Store"
                (takes Event)
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
              (block LocalPlanner
                (takes Receipt :as evt)
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
            (adjacent
              (block RetryCatalog :type "Feature"
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
              (block ShadowFeed :type "Feature"
                (takes Receipt)
                (gives Command)
                (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))
        (adjacent
          (block LocalCache
            (implements Observable)
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
          (block ShadowScheduler :type "Feature"
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
            (level
              (block Index
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))))))))
  (level
    (block EdgePlanner
      (takes Command)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
